reading: L03: «والصاحة ولغير السنين التى سيأتى على تفسير العمل به فيها»: the sense of «والصاحة» is not clear (والصحة? المصالحة?); the print is kept.

L02: «آخر الساعة من ساعات القمر ـ ١٠٨٠»: the sentence gives the number of parts in an hour (1080, de Blois's section 4); «آخر», «the last», gives no clear sense here (اجزاء الساعة, «the parts of the hour»?); the print is kept.

L02: «١١٢٠٠٠٠٠٠٠٠» between «تشرى» and «يوم الخميس»: the sentence «فان رأس تشرى يوم الخميس» is complete without it, as in L04, L06-L07 and L13; whether the figure stands for a mark of the manuscript, a misplaced number or a row of dots set with the zero type is not known; the print is kept.

L15: «على ما فى التوراة وكتب الانبياء واخبار الآن كان وسط الشمس ...»: «واخبار الآن» gives no clear sense («the reports of now»?); whether a word is missing after «واخبار» or «الآن» begins the next sentence is not clear; the print is kept.
L17: Saturn on the first day of Adam, «ح نه»: نه (55) cannot be a number of degrees; whether the degrees are missing or a letter is misread is not known; the print is kept.

L01-L02: the positions of Jupiter, Mars, Venus and Mercury at the building of the Temple, «ج ـ رمت لد», «يخ انه كور», «رنب يامر» and «الج يط اط», are not regular abjad groups (ر, 200, cannot stand for a sign, degrees or minutes, and «مت», «انه», «كور», «يامر» are not abjad numbers); they cannot be restored from the print; the print is kept.

L03-L04 and L06: the apogee of the moon «ر كو ير يط» and Mercury «ر ى الح» begin with ر (200), which cannot stand for a sign, and «ير» is not an abjad number; with ز for ر (a missing dot) the apogee would read 7 signs 26 degrees 17 minutes 19 seconds and Mercury would begin with 7 signs 10 degrees; not checked against the author's tables; the print is kept.
